records.decision: remove the duplicated positivity quantifier while retaining the exact domain and order condition
records.source_normalized_snippet: \begin{defn} A linear functional $\tau$ on a $C^*$-algebra $A$ is \index{positive!linear functional}% \index{linear!functional!positive}% \df{positive} if $\tau(a) \ge 0$ whenever $a \ge \vc 0$ in~$A$ for all $a \in A$. \end{defn}
records.target_normalized_snippet: \begin{defn} Suatu fungsional linear $\tau$ pada aljabar-$C^*$ $A$ bersifat \index{positif!fungsional linear}% \index{linear!fungsional!positif}% \df{positif} jika $\tau(a) \ge 0$ untuk setiap $a \in A$ yang memenuhi $a \ge \vc 0$. \end{defn}

records.decision: define a state on a possibly nonunital C-star algebra as a positive norm-one functional and state the identity criterion only as the unital equivalent
records.source_normalized_snippet: \begin{defn} A \index{state}% \df{state} of a $C^*$-algebra $A$ is a positive linear functional $\tau$ on $A$ such that $\tau(\vc 1) = 1$. \end{defn}
records.target_normalized_snippet: \begin{defn} Suatu \index{keadaan}% \df{keadaan} pada aljabar-$C^*$ $A$ adalah fungsional linear positif $\tau$ pada $A$ sedemikian sehingga $\norm\tau = 1$. Jika $A$ beridentitas, syarat ini ekuivalen dengan $\tau(\vc 1_A) = 1$. \end{defn}

records.decision: restrict the norm-at-the-identity positivity criterion to a unital C-star algebra so that the displayed identity exists
records.source_normalized_snippet: \begin{prop} A linear functional $\tau$ on a $C^*$-algebra $A$ is positive if and only if it is bounded and $\norm\tau = \tau(\vc 1_A)$. \end{prop}
records.target_normalized_snippet: \begin{prop} Suatu fungsional linear $\tau$ pada aljabar-$C^*$ beridentitas $A$ bersifat positif jika dan hanya jika fungsional itu terbatas dan $\norm\tau = \tau(\vc 1_A)$. \end{prop}

records.source_normalized_snippet: \begin{exer} Let $X$ be a locally compact Hausdorff space. Find an isometric (therefore faithful) representation $(\pi,H)$ of the $C^*$-algebra $C_0(X)$ on some Hilbert space~$H$.. \end{exer}
records.target_normalized_snippet: \begin{exer} Misalkan $X$ suatu ruang Hausdorff kompak lokal. Carilah suatu representasi isometrik (dan karena itu setia) $(\pi,H)$ dari aljabar-$C^*$ $C_0(X)$ pada suatu ruang Hilbert~$H$. \end{exer}

records.source_normalized_snippet: \begin{notn} In the following material $\pi_\rho$, $H_\rho$, and $x_\rho$ are the cyclic representation, the Hilbert space, and the unit cyclic vector guaranteed by the GNS-construction starting with a given state $\rho$ of a $C^*$-algebra \end{notn}
records.target_normalized_snippet: \begin{notn} Dalam pembahasan berikut, $\pi_\rho$, $H_\rho$, dan $x_\rho$ adalah representasi siklik, ruang Hilbert, dan vektor satuan siklik yang keberadaannya dijamin oleh konstruksi GNS ketika diterapkan pada suatu keadaan $\rho$ yang diberikan pada suatu aljabar-$C^*$ $A$. \end{notn}
